description.el: Ανακαλύψτε το Milos Breeze Boutique Hotel στη Pollonia της Μήλου.
description.en: A stylish boutique hotel in Pollonia offering sea views and a relaxed island atmosphere.

about:
Milos Breeze is a four-star boutique hotel in Pollonia, the fishing village in the north-east of Milos. It is built in Cycladic style with modern interiors. Most rooms look out to sea, and many have panoramic views over the Aegean.

Room types range from sea-view doubles to rooms with an outdoor jacuzzi or a private pool, a honeymoon suite with a plunge pool, and a 60 m² villa with its own hammam and plunge pool. The hotel has its own restaurant, Blue by Breeze, serving Greek and Mediterranean food, and offers massages. Pollonia's fish tavernas and the boat to Kimolos are within easy reach.

description.el: Ανακαλύψτε το PORTIANI HOTEL Ξενοδοχείο στη Adamas της Μήλου.
description.en: A well-located hotel steps from the port of Adamas, ideal as a base for exploring Milos.

about:
Portiani is a small hotel in the centre of Adamas, about 200 metres from the harbour, with views over the bay of Milos. It suits travellers arriving by ferry who want to be close to the port, buses, car rental and tavernas without needing a car.

The rooms are spread over two floors. Most have a balcony, and the upper floor has verandas looking out to sea. Rooms are air-conditioned, with a private bathroom, fridge and TV. A buffet breakfast is served each morning, and there is a café-bar. The nearest beach is a few minutes' walk away.

description.el: Ανακαλύψτε το Santa Maria Village Resort & Spa στη Adamas της Μήλου.
description.en: A charming villa complex near Adamas with traditional Cycladic architecture.

about:
Santa Maria Village is a four-star resort and spa on a hillside a few minutes above the centre of Adamas. A footpath leads down to the village's shops and tavernas. The gardens are planted with olive and lemon trees, and the pool and pool bar look out over the bay of Milos.

Rooms range from garden doubles and triples to superior rooms with pool or sea views, junior suites with a private outdoor jacuzzi, and larger suites of up to 65 m². A breakfast buffet with Greek organic products is served daily, and there are spa and wellness treatments. The hotel is a good base for exploring the island by car.

description.el: Ανακαλύψτε το Hotel Adamas στη Adamas της Μήλου.
description.en: A comfortable hotel in Adamas with easy access to the island's main amenities.

about:
Hotel Adamas stands above the port of Adamas, a few metres from Lagada, the sandy town beach. It is a convenient base for travellers arriving by ferry, with the harbour, shops and tavernas of Adamas on the doorstep.

Rooms are decorated in a traditional Cycladic style, and many have large balconies or verandas with sea views. Breakfast features fresh local products. The hotel has a roof garden with an Italian restaurant and a bar looking out over the port, which is a pleasant place for a drink at sunset. Transfers, tours and excursions around the island can be arranged at reception.

description.el: Ανακαλύψτε το Milos Vaos Windmill στη Plaka της Μήλου.
description.en: A unique converted windmill in Plaka offering an unforgettable stay with stunning views.

about:
Vaos Windmill is a converted windmill in Tripiti, the hilltop village between Plaka and the sea, with sweeping views over the bay of Milos. It has been turned into a two-bedroom house that sleeps up to four, with a fully equipped kitchen and a terrace for watching the sunset.

The house is spread over three floors connected by stairs, and parking is about 200 metres away. It suits couples or a small family who are happy with steps, rather than anyone with limited mobility. The Catacombs, the ancient theatre and the fishing village of Klima are all within walking distance, and Plaka is a short walk up the hill.

description.el: Ανακαλύψτε το Nefeli Sunset Studios στη Pollonia της Μήλου.
description.en: A peaceful hotel in Pollonia, the ideal spot for exploring the northeast of the island and enjoying sunsets.

about:
Nefeli Sunset Studios is a small boutique complex of studios and suites in Pollonia, on the north-east coast of Milos. The buildings follow Cycladic tradition, with whitewashed walls, rounded corners and verandas, mixed with contemporary design, set around a Cycladic garden.

As the name suggests, the property is known for its sunset views over the Aegean. A choice of room sizes makes it suitable for couples as well as families. The property opens from April to October and can also arrange discounted car rental. Pollonia's beach, fish tavernas and the boat to Kimolos are close by.

description.el: Ανακαλύψτε το Kapetan Tasos Suites στη Pollonia της Μήλου.
description.en: Cosy studios in Pollonia run by a local family, offering authentic hospitality.

about:
Kapetan Tasos is a small complex of eleven suites in Pollonia, about 80 metres from a sandy beach and 300 metres from the village's main beach, which is shaded by tamarisk trees. It is built in local Cycladic style, with white walls, soft colours and plenty of natural light.

The suites come in one-, two- and three-room layouts. Junior suites suit couples, while the larger suites have a separate bedroom and a living room with sofa beds. The top-floor Superior Suite has two bedrooms, a full kitchen and wide sea-view verandas, which makes it a good option for families. Pollonia's tavernas and the boat to Kimolos are a short walk away.

description.el: Ανακαλύψτε το Kalea Suites στη Pollonia της Μήλου.
description.en: Modern suites in Pollonia, combining contemporary design with traditional island aesthetics.

about:
Kalea Suites is a newly built boutique property in Pollonia, about 50 metres from the sea and a short walk from the village's sandy beach. It is built from natural stone with whitewashed finishes, around a central pool framed by pergolas.

The suites are spread over two floors. Ground-floor suites have direct access to the pool, and several sleep up to four with sofa beds, which suits families. On the first floor are superior suites with private balconies, and a signature suite with its own jacuzzi on the terrace. Pollonia's fish tavernas, cafés and the boat to Kimolos are all within walking distance.

description.el: Ανακαλύψτε το Heavenly Milos στη Agia Kyriaki της Μήλου.
description.en: Secluded villas in Agia Kyriaki offering privacy and stunning views across the island.

about:
Heavenly Milos is a pair of suites, the Cyclades Suite and the Thalassa Suite, in Agia Kyriaki, on the quiet south-eastern side of Milos. Each is about 40 m², decorated by the owners with natural materials inspired by the island, and each has a private terrace with daybeds looking out over the Aegean.

Guests often mention watching the sunrise and the moonrise over the sea from the terraces. The location is quiet and rural, about 15 minutes by car from the port of Adamas. Having a car is essential, but the south-coast beaches of Agia Kyriaki, Paleochori and Firiplaka are all close by. There is private parking.

description.el: Ανακαλύψτε το Ξενοδοχείο Ρήγας στη Adamas της Μήλου.
description.en: Elegant accommodation in Adamas, blending local tradition with modern comfort.

about:
Hotel Rigas is a small hotel with nine rooms in Adamas, about 50 metres from the sea, 250 metres from Papikinou beach and 700 metres from the ferry port. The Mining Museum of Milos is almost next door, and a bus stop is about 100 metres away, so it works well without a car.

Rooms are deluxe doubles, triples and quads of 25 to 40 m², each with a balcony or veranda and air conditioning. Free breakfast is served in a traditional breakfast room, with local pies, homemade marmalade, yoghurt and fruit from the hotel's garden. Parking, Wi-Fi and luggage storage are free, and e-bikes and cars can be hired on site.

description.el: Ανακαλύψτε το Νηρηίδες στη Pachaina της Μήλου.
description.en: A beautiful property in Pachaina with views of the sea and traditional architecture.

about:
Niriides is a small complex of studios and apartments in Cycladic style at Pachaina, on the north coast of Milos, about 150 metres from Pachaina beach. The area is quiet, between Sarakiniko and Pollonia. Pachaina is a small sandy beach with views of the Glaronisia, the islets made of tall columns of volcanic rock.

Each unit has a furnished balcony and a kitchenette with a hob, fridge and coffee machine, which makes self-catering easy. There is free parking nearby. A car is useful here, since Adamas is about 7 km away. In return you get easy access to the north-coast beaches, Papafragas and the ruins of ancient Phylakopi.
